title: Breaking Poseidon1: An Algebraically Engineered MDS Matrix and a Full Collision
description: Poseidon1 is a core ZK-friendly hash function widely adopted across L1/L2 proving systems. In this talk, we present a complete 16-coordinate multi-tier collision against Poseidon1 over the KoalaBear prime. We break down the algebraic technique used to construct a custom MDS matrix by solving a system of 16 linear equations. We design the MDS matrix to cancel internal state differences across full and partial rounds, forcing the final hash outputs to collide under feed-forward. We will share insights from AI-assisted cryptanalysis (GPT 5.6 Pro) and verification, and actionable guidelines for selecting secure hash functions in ZK proof systems.
